text: Korean-style kalbi has a balance of sweet and savory flavors.
It's a common Korean recipe that you can now add to your menu.
Kalbi are short ribs cut on the cross section.
If you can't find them in your grocery store, have your butcher help you out.
Start with a very large bowl that you'll be able to fit the beef in.
Add six cloves of minced garlic, half of a large minced onion, one cup of brown sugar,
and three teaspoons of ground black pepper.
Mix to combine all the ingredients.
To the same bowl, add two-thirds of a cup of soy sauce, a quarter of a cup of sesame
Now, add four pounds of beef short ribs and allow them to marinate for at least 30 minutes
Preheat your grill to medium-high and cook for two to three minutes on each side.
Eat hot off the grill or cut the meat from the bone and wrap the meat around the bone
and wrap them in a lettuce leaf with rice and hot sauce, which is known as a ssam.
